# Pull request

Use this skill for governed pull-request lifecycle work.

- Preserve the requested lifecycle boundary; creating or repairing a PR does not imply merge authority.
- Keep PR metadata aligned with the accepted Issue and repository governance.
- When Inari is available, obtain the current PR procedure with `inari skill <scenario>` and use the Inari surface for governed PR operations.
- Inari use is limited to the organization-approved `inari pr`, `inari issue`, and `inari template` surfaces. Other advertised capabilities require explicit authorization.
- Do not silently substitute lower-level GitHub tooling for an Inari-governed operation.
- Do not duplicate or guess Inari command semantics in this file.
